events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Migration paused after batch 3: 120 of 400 records migrated; 280 remain. Validation reports 31 overseas customers have incorrect phone numbers because the old CRM omitted country codes and the new CRM added +1 to every number. Batches 4–10 would have the same problem. Fourteen sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours; whether they viewed or used the affected numbers is unknown. Please arrange an immediate warning to sales not to rely on migrated overseas phone numbers, and provide the affected customer IDs with verified international numbers so I can correct them. We also need the migration owner to fix country-code handling before I resume. I cannot identify the 31 records from the validation output available. I will send a consolidated completion report once the corrections and remaining migration are complete.
